up: Retrieve the molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, exact activity value, standard type, standard units, and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649954. sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649954' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
